purpose: Offline audit requirements, NOT an answer key or approved knowledge base. Never imported by runtime evaluator.
provenance: Assistant source review; all proposed semantic findings remain distinct from organizer Ground Truth.

facts.title: Tariff location and temporal meaning
facts.question_to_establish: Where is the tariff shown in web/report views, and which date does each displayed tariff represent?
facts.required_evidence: Entity/platform-specific UI guide and report-field definition with applicable version/date.
facts.limitation: Finding a field confirms this interaction, not historical/current tariff semantics or an unused alternative route.

facts.title: Trading and funding commissions
facts.question_to_establish: Which bank/broker charges apply to the specified funding or securities transaction?
facts.required_evidence: Applicable broker tariff plus transfer method, market, currency and bank conditions when relevant.
facts.limitation: An unanswered fee question can be identified without knowing the correct fee; never invent a fee or require irrelevant transaction fields.

facts.title: Bank-transfer details and currencies
facts.question_to_establish: Where are the relevant bank-transfer requisites obtained and which currencies are supported?
facts.required_evidence: Platform funding guide scoped to entity/version and currency, or direct observed task outcome.
facts.limitation: Obtaining requisites is not proof a transfer settled or that all currencies/banks are supported.

facts.title: Broker report generation
facts.question_to_establish: Where are reports downloaded and what do selected dates control?
facts.required_evidence: Report guide/schema or direct download confirmation for the requested report and period.
facts.limitation: A report download does not verify every financial figure or current tariff interpretation.

facts.title: Personal-data update route
facts.question_to_establish: Which task updates questionnaire data rather than bank details, and what prerequisites apply?
facts.required_evidence: Applicable profile-update guide or a narrowly confirmed task outcome.
facts.limitation: Cached guide is externally gathered, not organizer policy; context is absent in chats and the snapshot window is a team choice.

facts.title: Withdrawal after profile update
facts.question_to_establish: Must the update execute before withdrawal can be retried, and what timing can be promised?
facts.required_evidence: Entity-specific withdrawal/update procedure and status semantics; actual account records for individual eligibility.
facts.limitation: Opening/submitting an update does not prove withdrawal unlocked. Bot repetition is not policy.

facts.title: Private account/order facts
facts.question_to_establish: Is a restriction, position, rejection reason or other private state actually present?
facts.required_evidence: Authorized account/order records or reliable system evidence for that exact account and time.
facts.limitation: Public FAQs cannot verify private state. The disclosure act and verification ordering can still be judged from the transcript.

facts.title: Verification prerequisite for protected disclosure
facts.question_to_establish: Was identity confirmed before the protected disclosure/action?
facts.required_evidence: Organizer checklist criterion3 and source sequence establishing protected conduct and verification confirmation.
facts.limitation: No separate product manual is needed to apply the supplied grading prerequisite. Whether a particular action is protected may require case-specific context.

facts.title: Information-site versus trading access
facts.question_to_establish: Which company site is informational and which web/app route serves the relevant trading account?
facts.required_evidence: Entity/domain/platform mapping or explicit successful access in this interaction.
facts.limitation: Language does not establish jurisdiction. Success on one route does not verify every alternative or a blanket no-login claim.

facts.title: Login reuse after closure
facts.question_to_establish: Does the old login remain reserved after closing an account, and can/when it be reused?
facts.required_evidence: Official registration/account-closure username policy for the correct entity.
facts.limitation: Thanking the agent or choosing another login does not establish permanence or release timing.

facts.title: Security search and order navigation
facts.question_to_establish: How does a customer locate the intended bond/share and proceed toward an order?
facts.required_evidence: Applicable platform search/order guide or a narrowly confirmed search/opening outcome.
facts.limitation: Seeing a search bar, opening Quotes, finding a security and submitting a trade are different outcomes.

facts.title: Margin control location
facts.question_to_establish: Where can Use Margin be disabled before order submission?
facts.required_evidence: Order-entry guide or explicit confirmation for the particular control/action.
facts.limitation: Finding the control is not explicit proof of disabling it, but a concrete correct next step may still satisfy the request.

facts.title: Margin effect on existing holdings
facts.question_to_establish: Does changing an unsubmitted order setting affect existing positions?
facts.required_evidence: Applicable order/margin specification distinguishing new-order settings and existing positions.
facts.limitation: The customer finding a checkbox cannot verify position effects; deferring the question is not answering it.

facts.title: D-account versus trading account
facts.question_to_establish: Can D-account funds buy securities directly, and what route is appropriate when funds are there?
facts.required_evidence: Official product/account funding and trading eligibility documentation for the relevant entity.
facts.limitation: Do not invent transfer procedures. A restriction claim and an actionable path around a stated obstacle are separate requirements.

facts.title: Form1042-S language availability
facts.question_to_establish: In which languages does this provider supply the form, including requested Russian/Kazakh availability?
facts.required_evidence: Provider form/document policy; distinguish an original form from translations and guidance.
facts.limitation: Provided in English does not logically establish English-only or no local-language version.

facts.title: Company financial-statements navigation
facts.question_to_establish: Where are the holding/company financial statements, distinct from personal reports?
facts.required_evidence: Official investor-relations navigation or explicit confirmation of the requested page.
facts.limitation: The presentation describes the holding but gives no Investors-to-Financial-Information menu specification.

facts.title: Nasdaq versus NYSE explanation
facts.question_to_establish: Are they different exchanges and what supports the claimed sector comparison?
facts.required_evidence: Primary exchange descriptions or a separately stated general-knowledge evidence policy.
facts.limitation: Organizer presentation says FRHC trades on Nasdaq; it does not verify the operator sector comparison or classify NYSE.

facts.title: Support and personal-manager service scope
facts.question_to_establish: Which advice/account-access services may support or a personal manager provide, and what eligibility applies?
facts.required_evidence: Entity-specific service mandate, permissions and manager eligibility policy.
facts.limitation: A technical-support script does not verify portfolio thresholds or manager access permissions; marketing material is insufficient.

facts.title: Security-specific exchange/OTC availability
facts.question_to_establish: Is the named instrument exchange-tradable, OTC-only, or restricted by jurisdiction, and why is an order book visible?
facts.required_evidence: Dated instrument eligibility/execution information for the correct entity/jurisdiction and actual rejection diagnostics.
facts.limitation: Order rejection alone does not establish OTC-only status; internal colleague speech is not independent verification.

facts.title: Trader/support contact and hours
facts.question_to_establish: Which trader/support contact route, order process, support opening hours and market session apply?
facts.required_evidence: Official desk contact/process/hours for the relevant entity, market and date.
facts.limitation: Cached support-contact guide does not establish desk email, market-close assertions or minimum transaction fees.

facts.title: Internal OTC commission claim
facts.question_to_establish: Are the internally discussed minimum25USD/2percent terms applicable?
facts.required_evidence: Dated OTC tariff, transaction type and entity.
facts.limitation: This is internal consultation, not customer-facing advice; do not create a customer omission or deduction merely because the fee was not relayed.

facts.title: Demo-account reset
facts.question_to_establish: Can/when a demo account be deleted or reset and what must the user do first?
facts.required_evidence: Registration/demo lifecycle procedure and actual action evidence for a claimed completed deletion.
facts.limitation: Discussion of future deletion is not proof of a protected action completed; corrupted ASR terms must remain uncertain.

facts.title: Citizenship/residence document selection
facts.question_to_establish: Which citizenship, passport and residence-permit fields apply to registration?
facts.required_evidence: Onboarding/KYC documentation scoped to citizenship/residence, entity and application version.
facts.limitation: Do not treat unsupported registration guidance as verified legal/KYC advice merely because the customer understands it.

facts.title: Investigation and follow-up commitments
facts.question_to_establish: Did the operator offer a concrete appropriate investigation/follow-up step, and did any promised action actually occur?
facts.required_evidence: Dialogue establishes the commitment; backend records would establish actual completion when that is a grading requirement.
facts.limitation: The supplied rubric accepts an appropriate next step. Do not demand proof of eventual completion for every referral or turn every commitment into unverified policy.
